description: The Search Console API provides access to both Search Console data (verified users only) and to public information on an URL basis (anyone)

tools.name: url-inspection_inspect
tools.description: Index inspection. Optional: inspectionUrl, languageCode, siteUrl. Returns the new InspectUrlIndexResponse.

params.name: inspectionUrl
params.description: Required. URL to inspect. Must be under the property specified in 'site_url'.

params.name: languageCode
params.description: Optional. An [IETF BCP-47](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) language code representing the requested language for translated issue messages, e.g. 'en-US', 'or 'de-CH'. Default value is 'en-US'.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: Required. The URL of the property as defined in Search Console. **Examples:** `http://www.example.com/` for a URL-prefix property, or `sc-domain:example.com` for a Domain property.

tools.name: url-testing-tools_run
tools.description: Runs Mobile-Friendly Test for a given URL. Optional: requestScreenshot, url. Returns the new RunMobileFriendlyTestResponse.

params.name: requestScreenshot
params.description: Whether or not screenshot is requested. Default is false.

params.name: url
params.description: URL for inspection.

tools.name: webmasters_searchanalytics-query
tools.description: Query your data with filters and parameters that you define. Returns zero or more rows grouped by the row keys that you define. You must define a date range of one or more days. When date is one of the group by values, any days without data are omitted from the result list. If you need to know which days have data, issue a broad date range query grouped by date for any metric, and see which day rows are returned. Required: siteUrl. Optional: aggregationType, dataState, dimensionFilterGroups (plus 7 more).

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: `http://www.example.com/`.

params.name: aggregationType
params.description: [Optional; Default is 'auto'] How data is aggregated. If aggregated by property, all data for the same property is aggregated; if aggregated by page, all data is aggregated by canonical URI. If you filter or group by page, choose AUTO; otherwise you can aggregate either by property or by page, depending on how you want your data calculated; see the help documentation to learn how data is calculated differently by site versus by page. **Note:** If you group or filter by page, you cannot aggregate by property. If you specify any value other than AUTO, the aggregation type in the result will match the requested type, or if you request an invalid type, you will get an error. The API will never change your aggregation type if the requested type is invalid.

params.name: dataState
params.description: The data state to be fetched, can be full or all, the latter including full and partial data.

params.name: dimensionFilterGroups
params.description: [Optional] Zero or more filters to apply to the dimension grouping values; for example, 'query contains 'buy'' to see only data where the query string contains the substring 'buy' (not case-sensitive). You can filter by a dimension without grouping by it.

params.name: dimensions
params.description: [Optional] Zero or more dimensions to group results by. Dimensions are the group-by values in the Search Analytics page. Dimensions are combined to create a unique row key for each row. Results are grouped in the order that you supply these dimensions.

params.name: endDate
params.description: [Required] End date of the requested date range, in YYYY-MM-DD format, in PST (UTC - 8:00). Must be greater than or equal to the start date. This value is included in the range.

params.name: rowLimit
params.description: [Optional; Default is 1000] The maximum number of rows to return. Must be a number from 1 to 25,000 (inclusive).

params.name: searchType
params.description: [Optional; Default is 'web'] The search type to filter for.

params.name: startDate
params.description: [Required] Start date of the requested date range, in YYYY-MM-DD format, in PST time (UTC - 8:00). Must be less than or equal to the end date. This value is included in the range.

params.name: startRow
params.description: [Optional; Default is 0] Zero-based index of the first row in the response. Must be a non-negative number.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional. [Optional; Default is 'web'] Type of report: search type, or either Discover or Gnews.

tools.name: webmasters_sitemaps-delete
tools.description: Deletes a sitemap from the Sitemaps report. Does not stop Google from crawling this sitemap or the URLs that were previously crawled in the deleted sitemap. Required: siteUrl, feedpath. Destructive.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: `http://www.example.com/`.

params.name: feedpath
params.description: The URL of the actual sitemap. For example: `http://www.example.com/sitemap.xml`.

tools.name: webmasters_sitemaps-get
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific sitemap. Required: siteUrl, feedpath. Returns the WmxSitemap.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: `http://www.example.com/`.

params.name: feedpath
params.description: The URL of the actual sitemap. For example: `http://www.example.com/sitemap.xml`.

tools.name: webmasters_sitemaps-list
tools.description: Lists the [sitemaps-entries](/webmaster-tools/v3/sitemaps) submitted for this site, or included in the sitemap index file (if `sitemapIndex` is specified in the request). Required: siteUrl. Optional: sitemapIndex. Returns the SitemapsListResponse.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: `http://www.example.com/`.

params.name: sitemapIndex
params.description: A URL of a site's sitemap index. For example: `http://www.example.com/sitemapindex.xml`.

tools.name: webmasters_sitemaps-submit
tools.description: Submits a sitemap for a site. Required: siteUrl, feedpath.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: `http://www.example.com/`.

params.name: feedpath
params.description: The URL of the actual sitemap. For example: `http://www.example.com/sitemap.xml`.

tools.name: webmasters_sites-add
tools.description: Adds a site to the set of the user's sites in Search Console. Required: siteUrl.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The URL of the site to add.

tools.name: webmasters_sites-delete
tools.description: Removes a site from the set of the user's Search Console sites. Required: siteUrl. Destructive.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The URI of the property as defined in Search Console. **Examples:** `http://www.example.com/` or `sc-domain:example.com`.

tools.name: webmasters_sites-get
tools.description: Retrieves information about specific site. Required: siteUrl. Returns the WmxSite.

params.name: siteUrl
params.description: The URI of the property as defined in Search Console. **Examples:** `http://www.example.com/` or `sc-domain:example.com`.

tools.name: webmasters_sites-list
tools.description: Lists the user's Search Console sites. Returns the SitesListResponse.
